description: Bus operator by service is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Travelwest. Details of bus operator contact details listed by bus service. This is used within the Travelwest website for web pages: Service Feedback and Lost Property and Operators Fares. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets. Its keywords are Travelwest, public transport, transport. The portal shows 203 records. The portal shows 2018-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
